properties.name: platform.queue.brokers.*.provider
properties.description: Provider backing a logical broker alias. Connectivity is configured with spring.kafka.* or spring.rabbitmq.*.

properties.name: platform.queue.destinations.*.broker
properties.description: Logical broker alias used by a destination.

properties.name: platform.queue.destinations.*.kafka.topic
properties.description: Physical Kafka topic mapped from a logical destination.

properties.name: platform.queue.destinations.*.rabbit.exchange
properties.description: Physical Rabbit exchange mapped from a logical destination.

properties.name: platform.queue.subscriptions.*.destination
properties.description: Logical destination consumed by a subscription.

properties.name: platform.queue.subscriptions.*.kafka.group-id
properties.description: Consumer identity of this dynamic logical subscription.

properties.name: platform.queue.subscriptions.*.kafka.mode
properties.description: Platform realtime, staged batch, or staged bulk delivery mode.
